marginType.description: Margin mode of the position (e.g. CROSS or ISOLATED).

entryPrice.description: Average entry price of the position.

markPrice.description: Latest mark price used to value the position.

symbol.description: Market symbol of the position (e.g. BTC-PERP).

side.description: Side of the position (BUY for long, SELL for short).

notionalValue.description: Notional value of the position, in the settlement currency.

settleWithAsset.description: Asset used to settle PnL and fees for this position.

unrealizedProfitLoss.description: Unrealized profit or loss at the latest mark price.

totalMaintenanceMargin.description: Total maintenance margin currently required for the position.

liquidationPrice.description: Estimated liquidation price based on the current margin and mark price.

isolatedLeverage.description: Isolated leverage configured on the position; only applicable in isolated margin mode.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the position snapshot, in milliseconds since epoch.

takeProfitOrder.description: Take-profit trigger currently attached to the position, if any.

stopLossOrder.description: Stop-loss trigger currently attached to the position, if any.

positionMode.description: Position mode: ONE_WAY (net position) or HEDGE (independent long and short positions).

positionDirection.description: Position direction in hedge mode (LONG or SHORT).

walletName.description: Name of the wallet holding the position.

currentLeverage.description: Effective leverage currently applied to the position.

minimumRequiredMargin.description: Minimum initial margin required to hold the position at its current size.
